name: expressive
label: Expressive
css: .style-expressive { background: var(--slide-surface, #FFFFFF); color: var(--slide-text, #111827); font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; position: relative; width: 1080px; height: 1080px; padding: 64px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; overflow: hidden; } .style-expressive::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -40%; right: -10%; width: 600px; height: 600px; background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--slide-primary, #db2777) 0%, transparent 70%); opacity: 0.08; border-radius: 50%; pointer-events: none; z-index: 0; } .style-expressive .hook { font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -2px; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); margin: 0; padding: 0; position: relative; z-index: 1; max-width: 90%; } .style-expressive .text { font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); margin: 32px 0 0 0; padding: 0; position: relative; z-index: 1; max-width: 85%; } .style-expressive .step { position: absolute; top: 64px; right: 64px; font-size: 160px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--slide-primary, #db2777); opacity: 0.12; line-height: 1; z-index: 0; } .style-expressive .brand { position: absolute; bottom: 64px; left: 64px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--slide-primary, #db2777); letter-spacing: 0.5px; z-index: 1; } .slide-code.style-expressive { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1a2e 0%, #16213e 100%); color: #e0e0e0; } .slide-code.style-expressive::before { background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--slide-primary, #db2777) 0%, transparent 70%); opacity: 0.05; } .slide-code.style-expressive .hook { color: #ffffff; text-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--slide-primary, #db2777); } .slide-code.style-expressive .text { color: #b0b0c0; } .slide-code.style-expressive .step { color: var(--slide-primary, #db2777); opacity: 0.15; } .slide-code.style-expressive .brand { color: var(--slide-primary, #db2777); } .slide-insight.style-expressive { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0f172a 0%, #1e293b 100%); color: #f1f5f9; } .slide-insight.style-expressive::before { background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--slide-primary, #db2777) 0%, transparent 70%); opacity: 0.06; } .slide-insight.style-expressive .hook { color: #ffffff; } .slide-insight.style-expressive .text { color: #cbd5e1; } .slide-insight.style-expressive .insight-text { font-size: 28px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.5; color: #f1f5f9; background: rgba(var(--slide-primary-rgb, 219, 39, 119), 0.15); padding: 24px; border-radius: 8px; border-left: 4px solid var(--slide-primary, #db2777); margin: 24px 0; position: relative; z-index: 1; } .slide-insight.style-expressive .step { color: var(--slide-primary, #db2777); opacity: 0.18; } .slide-insight.style-expressive .brand { color: var(--slide-primary, #db2777); }
